newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Tupras to issue bonuses, rights.
newsitem.headline: Turk Tupras to issue bonuses, rights.

text.p: Turkey's largely state-owned oil refineries Tupras - Turkiye Petrol Rafinerileri AS will issue bonuses and rights between July 14 and August 12 to increase its capital to 29,900.8 billion lira from current 4,672 billion.
The Istanbul Stock Exchange said Tupras would issue 2.7 bonuses and 2.7 rights per 1,000 lira-nominal valued existing share. Rights will be exercised at 1,000 lira nominal-value.
The right and bonus issues will total 12,614.4 billion lira each.
Tupras's major shareholder is Turkey's Privatisation administration (OIB) which holds a 96.41 percent stake.
